source_of_truth: Derived by hand from the build I wrote, not from the tool. The dynamic route /blog/[slug] (manifest key "/blog/[slug]/page") lists static/chunks/vendor-charting.js in clientModules with async:false, so it is in the route's INITIAL client set. That chunk is 300000 bytes raw of high-entropy base64; under gzipSync it is ~227 KB gzip, the single largest initial chunk and far above route-attribution's 150 KB cutoff. A dynamic route shipping a ~227 KB gzip chunk on first load is a genuine initial-weight defect. route-heavy-initial-chunk is HEURISTIC by design (hashed names hide the library), so heuristic is the strongest honest level. The finding is attributed to the route PATH, so line is null.
provenance: blind generalization: truth derived from source without consulting tool output
